labeling_instructions.source_policy: Use only information the company states on its own public website. No outside knowledge, no assumptions.

statuses.extracted: Directly stated on the site, with a verbatim (or near-verbatim) quote as evidence.
statuses.inferred: Allowed ONLY on the three whitelisted fields below. A reasonable read of stated evidence, not a direct quote.
statuses.not_found: The site does not provide sufficient evidence for this field.
statuses.conflicting: Two pages give genuinely incompatible values for the SAME single-valued attribute (see conflicting_vs_union rule below).

labeling_instructions.multi_value_evidence_rule: For any field in this list -- products.names, customers.industries, traction.named_customers, traction.certifications, traction.partnerships, comparisons.named_alternatives, pricing.public_plans -- check every value item against the evidence text individually. If one contiguous quote does not literally contain every item, make 'evidence' a list of quotes in the same order as 'value' (evidence[i] must support value[i]) instead of writing one summary sentence. Never let a paraphrase stand in as evidence for a list.
labeling_instructions.conflicting_vs_union_rule: Use 'conflicting' only for a single-valued field (e.g. company_identity.headquarters) where two pages state incompatible facts. For a list-valued field, do NOT mark it conflicting just because two pages list different or overlapping items -- merge every genuinely-sourced item into one list instead.

field_specific_rules.customers.segments: Single string. How the company classifies buyers by structure/size (individual, team, SMB, mid-market, enterprise, nonprofit, government). Stays a single string -- do not turn into a list.
field_specific_rules.customers.industries: List. The named verticals, sectors, or professions the site explicitly says it serves. Each item must be a term the site itself uses, not a category you infer.
field_specific_rules.products.names: List. Counts only if the company treats the text as a proper name for something it sells: a nav item linking to its own product page, a product-page title/heading, or explicit 'Introducing X' branding. A descriptive phrase ('our platform') does not count. Tiebreaker: does the term have its own page/URL on the site?
field_specific_rules.pricing.sales_motion: Inference allowed. 'Contact sales' with no public amounts -> sales-led (inferred). Do not infer subscription pricing from 'Contact sales' alone.
field_specific_rules.pricing.revenue_model: Inference allowed, but only from a structural signal the site states outright (per seat, monthly subscription, transaction fee, one-time license). Never infer from company type/category alone.
field_specific_rules.products.delivery_model: Inference allowed, but only from the site's own words describing how the product is delivered (self-serve, managed service, app download, physical + install). Never infer from category assumptions.
field_specific_rules.pricing.free_trial: Single string. Quote the site's own trial/demo phrasing verbatim (e.g. '14-day free trial, no credit card required'). Never normalize to yes/no.
field_specific_rules.traction.certifications: List. Compliance/standards marks (SOC 2, ISO, ...) or named partner-tier badges issued by a third party.
field_specific_rules.traction.partnerships: List. Named companies described as integration, channel, or technology partners.
field_specific_rules.traction.named_customers: List. Entities described as using/buying the product (logos, 'trusted by', case studies, testimonials). A name may legitimately appear in both this field and partnerships/certifications if the site describes it both ways -- that's not an error.

company_identity.description.value: LeadSquared is an AI-powered CRM and growth platform that unites marketing, sales, service, onboarding and operations in one connected system.
company_identity.description.evidence: LeadSquared unites every growth function — marketing, sales, service, onboarding, and operations — into one connected system, giving enterprises the speed, intelligence, and control they need to scale.

company_identity.headquarters.notes: No page states a headquarters or head office. The site footer shows 'Corporate Office Address: LeadSquared 2nd Floor, Omega Block, Embassy Tech Square, Kadubeesanahalli, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560103'. /contact/ lists offices in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Noida, New Jersey (Edison), Johannesburg, Dubai and Saudi Arabia, and /our-story/ has a 'Global presence' section with India, USA, UAE and South Africa addresses. Under Decision (d) an address or office list is not a headquarters statement. Pages checked: https://www.leadsquared.com/contact/ and /our-story/.

evidence: Invorto — AI that handles calls, qualifies leads, and books follow-ups, without a human on the line.
FloStack — Personalized buying experiences for every prospect.
products.names.notes: Footer Products list (first seven) and home "Products that power growth" cards (Invorto, FloStack). Other names the site uses for the same products: header menu 'Sales, Field Sales, Marketing, Service, Flostack'; home cards 'Marketing Suite, Service Cloud, Sales, Field Operations'. Single generic words and non-product footer links (Integrations, API, Dev Platform, Help Portal, Pricing) excluded.

products.delivery_model.value: Software: cloud-based CRM platform hosted on AWS, with a mobile app and APIs
products.delivery_model.evidence: LeadSquared applications and services are all hosted in Amazon Web Services across its multiple regions. | Mobile App | API
products.delivery_model.notes: The last two are footer labels on https://www.leadsquared.com/.

customers.segments.evidence: giving enterprises the speed, intelligence, and control they need to scale
customers.segments.notes: The pricing pages also offer 'Special Pricing for Select Startups (terms and conditions apply)'. Single value kept per the field rule.

customers.industries.notes: First six from the header Industries menu and home "Industry-smart" section; last six from the footer Industries list. Footer labels have the 'CRM' suffix dropped. Education and Manufacturing appear in both lists and are listed once. The header menu also shows 'Others', excluded as generic.

pricing.public_plans.notes: The marketing pages state 'per account' with no billing period. Every plan button reads 'Let's Talk'. /pricing/ redirects to the marketing page. The Service CRM has no public plan page.

pricing.sales_motion.notes: Public prices exist but every plan's call to action is Let's Talk; the home page offers 'Book a demo' and no sign-up.

pricing.free_trial.notes: No trial wording on the home, pricing or compare pages, in any link text, or in the pricing-page FAQ answers (checked by Uttam on 2026-10-10). 'Special Pricing for Select Startups' is a discount, not a trial.

evidence: LeadSquared has brought structure and efficiency to our processes, enabling teams across Bajaj Capital to quickly adapt to market shifts while remaining service-ready for every customer.
traction.named_customers.notes: Logo-only customers seen on /our-story/ and the home page, not labelled because the logo alt text is generic ('company logo' on /our-story/) or has not been checked: University of the Southwest, Posterity Health, College Vidya, Keystone Universe of Education, Prism Johnson Limited, LIC HFL, a logo whose file name reads Sacramento-Ultrasound-Institute, Hippo Homes, co·learn, Irish Expert, CK Birla Hospital, Muthoot Housing Finance, HDFC Securities, Kotak. The site's own image file names are not used as evidence. Meritto appears only inside a customer quote and is excluded. Investors shown on /our-story/ (Westbridge Capital, Gaja Capital, IFC, Jyoti Bansal) are not customers.

evidence: LeadSquared is ISO 27001:2022 certified by the British Standards Institute (BSI).
traction.certifications.notes: Home Security & Compliance tile: AUDITED — CERT-In empanelled — Security audits by Government-empanelled auditors. DPDP-ready and GDPR are laws and excluded under Decision (a). CERT-In empanelled describes the auditors; included as a third-party audit badge the site lists with its certifications. Awards (Crozdesk, G2, Deloitte Fast 50, etc.) are not certifications.

traction.partnerships.notes: "Our leading partners" logo strip. Names confirmed from the logo alt text in the live DOM on 2026-10-10 and from the visible wordmarks; the alt text is lowercase or file-style, so the visible wordmark spelling is used (Tata Tele Business Services is the wordmark; alt reads 'tele business services'). An eighth logo, 'maestroSIS OPUS by BocaVox' (alt 'opus sis leadsquared partner program'), is not labelled because the spelling is ambiguous. The page lists partner programmes (Affiliate, Solutions, Technology, Startup) and a partner directory; '000+ Partners' is an animated counter.
